title: GitHub per-issue dependency list, as `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n}/dependencies/{blocked_by|blocking}` emits it (gatebraid/live-dependency-list@1)
description: A LIVE SURFACE, not a Gatebraid document: bytes GitHub produces, frozen so the state-reading toolchain can be tested against the shape it will actually meet. Introduced at M3 batch O1-B1 under ADR-0033's namespace rule and the operator's Route-A ruling. THIS IS THE SURFACE THE REPAIRED TRANSPORT MUST USE, and it is per-issue: the endpoint is addressed with an issue number and answers for that issue alone, which is precisely why the bulk `/issues` list cannot serve it. AN EMPTY ARRAY IS A LAWFUL ANSWER AND NOT A FAILED READ — measured, as a two-byte body, on an issue with no blocking edges. That distinction is the one a fail-open consumer destroys: a dropped edge and a genuinely absent edge produce the same empty set unless the read itself is known to have succeeded, so the corpus freezes the empty case as VALID to keep the two apart. REQUIRING `repository` IS THE ONE THING THIS SCHEMA ADDS to the issue shape, and it is a measured discriminator rather than a guess: all five dependency elements captured carry it, and all six issue objects from the bulk and single-issue surfaces lack it, across eleven elements with no exception. It is what makes a bulk body offered as a dependency answer fail here instead of validating — the document half of the cross-check the repaired tool must perform. The element shape is duplicated from `gatebraid/live-issue@1` rather than referenced across files, because every committed sibling schema uses internal `$defs` only and fixtures/run-corpus.py supplies a base URI for self-resolution rather than a multi-schema registry. `format` and `patternProperties` are deliberately absent, for the reasons the sibling schemas record.

dependencyIssue.description: One edge's far end, as the per-issue dependency surface emits it: an issue object carrying `repository`. Open vocabulary, closed state enumeration, plus the discriminator.

number.description: The issue number at the far end of the edge.

state.description: CLOSED enumeration. Both members were measured on this surface — four `closed` elements on one read, one `open` element on another. A satisfied edge is a CLOSED blocker, so a consumer that cannot represent `closed` here cannot decide startability at all.

repository.description: The measured discriminator of this surface. Present on every captured dependency element and absent from every captured bulk or single-issue element; requiring it is what makes a bulk body fail this schema. AN OBJECT, and the type is worth stating because the same key name carries a different type one surface away: on a Projects item-list element `repository` was measured as a STRING, while here it is the full repository resource — an 82-key object whose `full_name` names the repository. A consumer that assumes one shape because it met the other is the defect this pin exists to catch. The interior is deliberately left open: only the presence and the kind are load-bearing for a dependency read.
